blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Gilas Pilipinas produced two victories, including an upset of powerhouse Mongolia, on Monday at the start of its men’s 3×3 basketball competition campaign in the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 at Kinjo-futo Station Square. Nic Cabanero, Koji Buenaflor, Luis Pablo and Andrei Dungo stunned Mongolia, 19-12, before dominating Sri Lanka, 21-12, in Group A to move closer towards a quarterfinals berth in the halfcourt event. The Philippines can gain a direct entry to the quarters with a win over Kazakhstan on Wednesday. Teams that placed second and third in […]...
